brief: @buildthis.bisks.net A history of the ontology of social media platforms, from the precursors (usenet, phpBB) to the frontier (the various atproto communities, established and experimental), with attention to social affordances, how user relations are constituted and reified, etc. ❤️ Thank you!
note: built ontology.bisks.net: a history of what a "follow" or a "like" even is, usenet killfiles to phpBB post counts to the social graph to twitter to atproto putting the schema in public records anyone can read.
